disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 2 give mean and SD of eight elements, including lead and cadmium, by XRF in six imported and six locally produced vegetables from Baghdad wholesale markets.

study.design: market survey, imported versus locally produced vegetables
study.origin: imported (countries not stated) and locally produced in Iraq
study.market: four wholesale markets in Baghdad (Al-Taji, Al-Shuala, Al-Zaafaraniya, Al-Rasheed areas)
study.period_text: during 2016; imported in two batches at two times of year, local collected at two different times
study.method: X-ray fluorescence spectrometry on 3 g of oven-dried (70 C) powder sieved to 212 um
study.qa: no CRM, recovery or blank reported

regulatory_or_exposure.value: 310 and 372 ug per day for imported and local vegetables

unresolved: Number of samples per mean is not stated.
Cadmium means of 1.5 to 6 mg/kg dry by XRF are unusually high and the cadmium SDs are large relative to the means; no QA reported.
Printed page numbers (497, 494, 498) do not match the 794-802 range in the running header.
Onion is printed with the binomial Allium sativa (as printed).
Daily intake values are derived and not recorded as findings.
